api:
<Sunburst data={files} path={|f: &File| f.path} value={|f: &File| f.bytes} />
PropTypeDefault
dataone row per leafrequired
pathFn(&T) -> &str: "a/b/c"required
valueFn(&T) -> f64required
separatortext between levels"/"
rootlabel of the centre"Total"
levelsusize: rings drawn at onceall

Rows with the same path add up; parents are the sum of their children. Colours follow the top-level branch and get lighter with depth. Click a slice to make it the centre; click the centre to go back up. The tooltip shows the value, the share of the parent and the share of the total.

examples.title: Repository size
examples.description: Rings go from folders to subfolders; click a slice to zoom in and the centre to zoom out.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn files() {
    let data = use_signal(disk());
    rsx! { <Sunburst data={data} path={|l: &Leaf| l.path} value={|l: &Leaf| l.size} root="repo" class="h-96" /> }
}

examples.title: Deep tree
examples.description: Up to four levels with repeated paths summed.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn deep() {
    let data = use_signal(
        (0..40u64)
            .map(|index| Leaf {
                path: [
                    "a/b/c/d", "a/b/c/e", "a/b/f", "a/g/h/i", "a/g/h/j", "a/g/k", "l/m/n",
                    "l/m/o/p", "l/q", "r/s/t/u",
                ][(index % 10) as usize],
                size: 1. + noise(index) * 10.,
            })
            .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
    );
    rsx! { <Sunburst data={data} path={|l: &Leaf| l.path} value={|l: &Leaf| l.size} class="h-96" /> }
}
